news.label: Claude Ship Enters Beta
points: For Team and Enterprise plans on GitHub
Teams can require human sign-off on changes
details: It combines PR Steward, which handles CI failures and merge conflicts, with Claude Approvals, which decides on approvals based on your policies.
Teams can designate which changes need human approval. Starting auto-approval in monitor-only mode is recommended.

lines.say: First up, Anthropic has started the beta for Claude Ship.
lines.show: First up, Anthropic has started the beta for Claude Ship.

lines.say: It can take over the whole review flow, from fixing failing pull requests to approving them.
lines.show: It can handle the whole review flow, from fixing failing pull requests to approving them.

link.title: Introducing Claude Ship
link.description: Open a pull request and get back to building. Claude can now review pull requests, fix them, and approve the ones that a team's policy allows.

news.label: RobotBrain Warehouse
points: Recreates warehouses in 3D in your browser
Estimates eight hours of work in seconds
details: It rebuilds a warehouse in 3D from 360 degree camera footage and floor plans, then uses a physics engine to check how transport robots and equipment behave.
Current estimates are based on the input conditions, and accuracy checks against real-world data are planned for the future.

news.label: Printing Surfaces, Not Lines
points: Promising for light structures and robot parts
details: The study achieved 27 micrometer walls and reportedly cut defects such as surface waviness by up to 78 percent.
A special nozzle extrudes resin as a ribbon, and a self-healing carbomer gel holds the shape until it cures.
It is still at the research stage, though.

news.label: Blender 5.2.5 LTS
points: UV select picking hidden faces fixed
details: A crash caused by accessing armature data from another scene has been fixed.
A bug where UV circle and lasso select also picked hidden faces has been fixed.
The focus is on stability for the long term support release, not new features.

lines.say: Blender five point two point five L T S has been released.
It fixes crashes and selection bugs, so this is an update focused on stability.
lines.show: It fixes crashes and selection bugs, so this update is focused on stability.

news.label: Shirudo Protects Live Linux
points: Admins verify and approve before use
Blocked an attack without restarting Elasticsearch
details: It applies a temporary defense to running services until an official patch is installed.
In a controlled experiment, a defense generated by Codex blocked the attack. It does not replace official security patches.

lines.say: Open A I and Cisco have released Shirudo, which protects running Linux systems.
lines.show: OpenAI and Cisco have released Shirudo, which protects running Linux systems.

lines.say: It lets you apply a temporary defense until a patch becomes available.

link.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
link.description: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.
